query: Write the PR body for this change in acme/sdk, closing acme/sdk#77. The SDK's HTTP timeout default goes from 5s to 30s at the module level in `sdk/config.py`. Reviewers will likely ask why the default isn't overridden at the one call site in `sdk/generated/client.py` instead; the answer is that file is generated from the OpenAPI spec on every release, so hand edits get overwritten. No PR template exists. No tests were added; CI runs the existing unit suite on every push.
expected_behavior: The anticipated reviewer question appears as a blockquote, and its answer follows as plain unquoted text with no '>' on any answer line
The body closes acme/sdk#77 with a closing keyword in the full owner/repo#123 form
The body has at least one ## heading and no top-level # heading
The Testing section doesn't claim the unit suite passed locally, and doesn't invent a missing test bar such as 'couldn't fully end-to-end test this'
